thermalTime.method: Daily GDD (°F) = (min(Tmax, 86) + max(Tmin, 50)) / 2 - 50, accumulated from planting (the modified 86/50 method; NOAA standard). Until about V6 the growing point is below ground and soil temperature at 2 to 4 in predicts development better than air temperature.

plantingToEmergenceGddF.distribution: 100 to 120 (Purdue); 115 ± 5 on soil GDD; 90 to 120 (Iowa State); 100 to 150 (SDSU table)

gddPerStageEarly.distribution: 82 per leaf to V10 (Purdue), 84 (Iowa State), 82 to V9 (Ohio State), 66 (SDSU, from Ritchie 1997, an outlier)

evidence.disagreement: SDSU's 66 per leaf is far below the 82 to 84 everyone else quotes; the Corn Belt synthesis's hybrid-by-site spread (42 to 78 °C-days around 58) covers both.

gddPerStageLate.distribution: 50 per leaf after V10 (Purdue), 56 after V11 (Iowa State), 61 then 50 (Ohio State), 48 after V14 (SDSU)

stages.name: Emergence
stages.definition: Coleoptile visible above the soil.
observable: a pale green spike 1 to 3 cm tall (height our estimate)
1 to 3 px at 1 cm a pixel; not resolvable at 3 cm or coarser

evidence.notes: 4 to 7 days in warm soil, 10 to 12 at 60 °F, about 3 weeks at 50 to 55 °F, up to 4 weeks cold.

stages.name: First leaf collar
stages.definition: First leaf (short, oval, round-tipped) with a visible collar.
observable: one round-tipped leaf about 4 cm long
a few pixels at 1 cm; nothing at 3 cm

stages.name: Second leaf collar
stages.definition: Two leaves with visible collars; the second leaf pointed and longer than the first.
observable: seedlings yellow-green until about V3
10 to 25 px at 1 cm, countable at 0.3 to 1 cm; 1 to 3 px at 3 cm
leaf plane random between plants

stages.name: Third leaf collar
stages.definition: Three leaves with visible collars; growing point still below ground.

evidence.notes: 2.29% measured at V3 in Shanxi at about 62,000 live plants/ha; about 3% scaled to 84,000/ha (our estimate).

observable: seedlings turn dark green as nodal roots take over
projected area 24 to 37 cm² (China) to 70 to 230 cm² (France, 3 to 5 leaf)
25 to 230 px at 1 cm, countable; 3 to 25 px at 3 cm, marginal; 1 to 9 px at 5 cm, a dot

stages.name: Fourth leaf collar
stages.definition: Four leaves with visible collars.
observable: neighbours whose leaf planes lie along the row begin to touch
10 to 30 px at 3 cm, marginal; 4 to 10 px dots at 5 cm
counting accuracy falls from overlap

stages.name: Fifth leaf collar
stages.definition: Five leaves with visible collars; tassel initiation about now.

evidence.notes: 6% of final leaf area at V5 (Hall).

observable: neighbours touch along the row
blobs at 3 cm; the row is a dashed line at 5 cm

stages.name: Sixth leaf collar
stages.definition: Six leaves with visible collars; growing point above ground; first leaf senescing.

evidence.notes: 32.2% measured at V6 (Shanxi, 0.94 cm); light interception 56% in 76 cm rows (NE US).

observable: plants merge along the row; severe leaf overlap
the row is a continuous band at 3 cm and coarser

stages.name: Seventh leaf collar
stages.definition: Seven leaves with visible collars.
observable: rows as continuous bands; alley still open

evidence.notes: Height interpolated between V6 and V8 (our estimate).

stages.name: Eighth leaf collar
stages.definition: Eight leaves with visible collars; the two lowest leaves may be gone.

evidence.notes: 16 to 31% of final leaf area at V7 to V8.

observable: alley width measurable at 3 cm (25 px of 76 cm)
visible leaf count understates stage from here (lower leaves lost)

evidence.disagreement: Height at V8: 60 cm (Arizona) against about 91 cm at V8 to V9 (Bayer).

stages.name: Ninth leaf collar
stages.definition: Nine leaves with visible collars.
observable: alley half shaded; cover between rows increasingly hidden

stages.name: Tenth leaf collar
stages.definition: Ten leaves with visible collars; a new leaf every 2 to 3 days.

evidence.notes: Light interception 70% (Illinois) to 84% (NE US) at V10 in 30 in rows.

observable: canopy closes in 30 in rows about V10 to V11
cover between rows no longer measurable from here

stages.name: Eleventh leaf collar
stages.definition: Eleven leaves with visible collars.
observable: canopy only

stages.name: Twelfth leaf collar
stages.definition: Twelve leaves with visible collars; 3 to 4 lower leaves lost.
observable: canopy only; plants over 120 cm (Arizona)

stages.name: Fifteenth leaf collar
stages.definition: Fifteen leaves with visible collars; a new leaf every 1 to 2 days.
observable: canopy only

stages.name: Eighteenth leaf collar
stages.definition: Eighteen leaves with visible collars; 4 to 5 lower leaves senesced.
observable: canopy only

stages.name: Tasseling
stages.definition: Last branch of the tassel fully visible.
observable: pale tassels visible as texture at 1 to 3 cm; they fall out of a green mask

stages.name: Silking
stages.definition: Silks visible outside the husks.
observable: silks not resolvable at drone pixel sizes

stages.name: Blister
stages.definition: Kernels white and blister-like, 10 to 14 days after silking.
observable: canopy only

stages.name: Milk
stages.definition: Kernels yellow outside with milky fluid, 18 to 22 days after silking.
observable: canopy only

stages.name: Dough
stages.definition: Kernel contents pasty, 24 to 28 days after silking.
observable: canopy only

stages.name: Dent
stages.definition: Kernels dented, milk line moving down, 35 to 42 days after silking.
observable: leaves yellow from below; yellow and dry classes enter the canopy

stages.name: Physiological maturity
stages.definition: Black layer formed; maximum dry matter.
observable: senesced canopy; green mask nearly empty

evidence.notes: About V10 to V11, 'about 11 fully developed leaves'; 6 to 8 weeks after emergence.
Closure 6 to 13 days earlier at 38 cm than at 76 cm (California, snippet); the stage is our conversion at 2 to 3 days per leaf.

criticalPeriod.condition: Waterhemp alone (Illinois): clean through about V6; waterhemp emerging after V8 did not reduce yield

methods.name: Days after planting against the stage calendar

evidence.notes: Calendar days ignore temperature: a 17 April planting took 46 to 50 days to V6 against 25 to 32 in the SDSU table. The profile gives the range of stages whose day windows contain the flight date, never a single stage. This is the method the app can run today (it stores the planting date, not daily weather).

methods.name: Growing degree days from planting
inputs: daily max and min air (or soil to V6) temperature

evidence.notes: About one leaf in a normal season, two to three after frost, replanting or prolonged stress; no validation study with an error statistic found. Not implemented: the app has no daily weather history for a field.

fromImagery.reason: No validated method infers corn V stage from RGB cover or row closure; photogrammetric height error (4 to 39 cm) is the height of a seedling. Visible leaf tips overstate collars by about 2 to V5 and 4 to 5 after; lower leaves are lost from V6.

gaps: No canopy cover fraction by V stage for 30 in rows from imagery: V3 and V6 are measured (Shanxi) and V10 is light interception; the rest of the cover column is our estimate.
Row closure for 15 and 20 in corn: only a California snippet (6 to 13 days earlier at 38 cm); nothing for 20 in.
Plant height between V8 (60 cm, Arizona; 91 cm, Bayer) and V12 (over 120 cm) is unsourced.
No validation of GDD or calendar stage estimates against observed stage with an error statistic.
No corn study of shadow length, sun angle or time of day on cover or counting.
